notes: Seed URL www.votelubbock.org/elections-office/ returns HTTP 403 over http and HTTP 202 with an empty body over https; votelubbock.gov (named in a web search as the county elections site) also returns HTTP 202 with an empty body, including on a refreshed fetch, so the county's results page could not be read. lubbockcounty.gov home page has no election results link. Clarity: results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Lubbock/elections.json exists but is an empty list, so the check 1 script found no elections; no 2024 or 2026 Lubbock EIDs could be located (three web searches and the linked news pages gave none; Wikipedia only cites old EIDs 60299, 74828, 105035). EIDs were not probed by guessing. The Clarity Connect site lubbock-tx.connect.clarityelections.com is robots-disallowed for the fetch module. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin). Targeted pass 2026-10-02 (orchestrator + targeted-Lubbock): Clarity IDs found by bounded search; owner override to LIVE_PRECINCT (DECISIONS 52). targeted-Lubbock found news with county totals only. Format fix 2026-10-02: 2026_runoff county_totals_first_seen written in the standard form (was the Clarity timestamp '5/26/2026 7:24:54 PM CDT').
tag_rationale: Clarity update logs: Nov 2024 LIVE, Mar 2026 primary END, May 2026 runoff LATER, so the fixed rule gives UNKNOWN; the owner set LIVE_PRECINCT from the Nov 2024 general (owner_override).

2024_general.fact: Clarity EID 122846 (2024 General and Special Election; detail.xml Region Lubbock, ElectionDate 11/5/2024): election-day precinct numbers first at 11:46 PM CST and released again with changed numbers later that night (2 distinct releases).

2026_primary.fact: Clarity EIDs 126020 (2026 Republican Primary) and 126021 (2026 Democratic Primary), Region Lubbock, ElectionDate 3/3/2026: election-day precinct numbers appear once on election night (10:58 PM and 10:55 PM CST). Corroborating lead: Avalanche-Journal live blog (Yahoo copy, modified 11:28 PM CST) says election-day results were posted around 11 p.m.

2026_runoff.fact: Clarity EIDs 126277 (Democratic) and 126290 (Republican Primary Runoff), Region Lubbock, ElectionDate 5/26/2026: 3 election-night updates each with no election-day precinct numbers; election-day precinct numbers first at 11:48 AM and 11:51 AM CDT on May 27.
